question: Which of the following classical dances has its origin in Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sattriya:-
 
 
• "Sattriya" dance form belongs to Assam.__
 
• It was Introduced by the Vaishnava saint Shankaradeva in the 15th century A.D.
 
• Sattriya dance includes Nritta, Nritya, and Natya.
